findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe file write operations
 * @description Writing to files without proper validation may allow overwriting sensitive files
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/dotenv-unsafe-file-write
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-73
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rename"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["move", "copy", "copy2", "copyfile"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may be exploitable if path is user-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe file write operations that could allow writing to arbitrary locations or overwriting sensitive files

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file usage
 * @description Using insecure temporary file operations may expose sensitive data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dotenv-insecure-temp-file
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp", "NamedTemporaryFile", "TemporaryFile"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially insecure temporary file operation."
findings.hypothesis: Check for insecure temporary file usage that could expose sensitive .env data
